motion.name: button-color
motion.purpose: Button background and text transitions; none under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Save button
components.css: .ds-save { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--creator-accent, #b2d7c5); color: #182b23; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-save:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #ceeadb; } .ds-save:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; } .ds-save:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6ce95; outline-offset: 3px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-save { transition: none; } }

components.name: Preset button
components.css: .ds-preset { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #53665c; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--creator-bg, #151d1e); color: var(--creator-text, #f1f4f1); font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-preset:hover { background: #293a32; } .ds-preset[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--creator-accent, #b2d7c5); background: #304b3d; color: #d5f0df; } .ds-preset:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6ce95; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ring name
components.description: Editable name in the save footer.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--creator-muted, #b1c0ba); font-size: 12px; } .ds-field input { display: block; margin-top: 7px; min-height: 44px; background: #152019; color: var(--creator-text, #f1f4f1); border: 1px solid #53665c; border-radius: 5px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 14px; caret-color: var(--creator-accent, #b2d7c5); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6ce95; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Category tabs
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 2px; padding: 8px; background: var(--creator-bg, #151d1e); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--creator-line, #3c4b47); } .ds-tabs button { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--creator-muted, #b1c0ba); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { background: #293a32; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--creator-accent, #b2d7c5); color: #182b23; font-weight: 650; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6ce95; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Color swatch
components.css: .ds-swatch { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid transparent; background: #214e68; cursor: pointer; } .ds-swatch[aria-pressed="true"] { outline: 2px solid var(--creator-text, #f1f4f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e6ce95; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The implemented creator pairs dark green-gray controls with mint selection states and a neutral, lit 3D studio. The wrestler is the visual focus; compact labeled controls support immediate customization. This document records the existing creator surface, not a new brand identity.
dos: Do keep the live wrestler visible beside customization controls.
Do retain explicit labels, visible focus, and practical touch targets; most buttons and fields are at least 44px high.
Do keep the existing dark and mint visual authority.
donts: Don't make inspection controls the primary creator experience.
Don't compress the playable interface into a narrow portrait phone layout.
